inputs.title: NGC 3132: the gas density of Monteiro et al. (2025) on a grid of 101 cells a side
inputs.acquisition: The text file as the authors' repository serves it (structure_visualization/), downloaded unchanged; not tracked and not republished. Read by the image-layer bake for where each sight line's gas is.
inputs.license: The repository states no licence; the paper says its model's files "have been made available" there. Used as published numbers, with the paper cited.
